name: the Chicago Brewery

proprietors.name: Crawford
proprietors.basis: The register holds this printed name as person_crawford with action 'new_resident': the town does not carry a card for them under an id this record can name, so the reading is the name and not yet a person. Dated by the printing window, which bounds the reading and does not date the partnership.

staff.name: Thomas Cavanagh
staff.basis: The staffing model puts 2 of this role in a brewery at the typical band and 3 at the high end, on directory_1839. 3 brewers in 1839 for 2 breweries in the 1835 census — the principals only; the mash was worked by hands the list booked as labourers. This person is a reconstructed resident of the trade with no workplace of their own; the house is one the business layer already holds, and this row points at it rather than raising anything. Seated by tools/seat_reconstructed_trades_1835.py (T-1433) off 1835_business_staffing_model#brewery.labourer; carried onto this record by tools/staff_the_houses_1835.py (T-1462).
staff.replaceable_by: a source naming where this person worked, which retires the draw

staffing.basis: the 1835 business staffing model's band for this class, with the reconstructed seats T-1433 put in this house marked drawn
staffing.replaceable_by: a source naming the hands of this house, which retires every reconstructed seat it covers

shortfall.statement: The staffing model puts 2 hand(s) about this kind of house at its typical band and this house carries 3. It is at its band.
shortfall.counted_here: the reconstructed hands this overlay seats. A hand a SOURCE names carries its own citation in staff[] and is counted by the attested join, not by this.
shortfall.replaceable_by: a source naming a hand at this house, which retires the seat it replaces, or the mint T-1448 ordered, which draws the rest

locations.basis: The register resolved no place for this house at the scene date.
locations.limit_reason: No street the model holds. The paper gives no anchor.

dates.basis: No opening is announced. The first printing, 1835-06-20, is the bound: the house was trading by then and the record does not say when it began.

proprietor_community.basis: This record names nobody the resident layer holds a card for, so there is no person to read a community off. The silence is in the register.

replaceable_by: A directory, a deed or a later reading that names this house's premises, its staff or its dates more exactly than the newspapers do.
